**Welch Allyn** ophthalmology tools usually refers to the brand’s **ophthalmoscopes**, which are handheld instruments used to examine the retina, plus related eye-exam tools that are often sold in **diagnostic sets** with an **otoscope** and power handle.[2][4]

Common Welch Allyn eye-exam tools include:

- **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope** — a wide-view ophthalmic tool with **Quick Eye** alignment technology for easier optic disc alignment.[3][4]
- **PanOptic Basic LED Ophthalmoscope** — a wide-field ophthalmoscope with LED illumination.[1]
- **Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** — a traditional ophthalmoscope design used in standard diagnostic sets.[1][6]
- **Pocket ophthalmoscope** models — compact, portable versions for general use.[2][6]
- **Retinoscopes** — also part of Welch Allyn’s ophthalmic catalog.[2]

If you mean **“what tools does Welch Allyn make for ophthalmology?”**, the main items are the ophthalmoscopes above; if you mean **“which Welch Allyn set should I buy?”**, the answer depends on whether you want a **wide-view**, **standard**, or **budget** diagnostic set.[1][4]
